name: @dopame/acde-api
description: acde SDK: one devDependency makes a web app (React, Vue, Svelte, any Vite / Next.js / Nuxt / SvelteKit / Astro / Angular project) an acde app. Types of acde.config.jsonc, the manifest, the services and the acde:* modules; load() for optional acde:* modules; the Vite plugin (@dopame/acde-api/vite). The tools are acde app new / check / build / install / run
